evidence: The ALD Y2O3 films were deposited using the ASO NanoTech equipment (Makhachkala, Russia). The setup was equipped by a vacuum chamber with hot walls for the inlet of a viscous inert gas. Ultra high purity nitrogen (UHP, 99.9999%) was used as the carrier gas. In the ALD process, the N2 pressure in the reactor was kept at a level of ~1.0 Тorr.
